summary: Iter151 — Evidence Fusion v2 (Certezza diagnosi) end-to-end regression. Row fusion-row-10.10.41.50 shows Max 97% + 'Spento volutamente 91% · completo'; click opens fusion-detail-10.10.41.50 with fusion-evidence-10.10.41.50 listing 6 evidence items (Connettore/Tabella MAC/Datto RMM/Porta switch/Memoria porta/Orario abituale). Toggle fusion-v2-toggle triggers window.confirm(accept) → activated then re-toggled OFF. Sidebar link /certainty defined in Layout.js line 129 (admin only). NOTE ON SEEDING: datto_devices doc for PC-MARIO gets overwritten by a periodic datto sync — re-run tests/seed_fusion_iter151.py immediately before testing to guarantee datto evidence is present (without it PC-MARIO confidence drops to 86, below the ≥88 target). Task-provided seed script was run right before the passing test run.

minor.issue: datto_devices doc inserted by seed_fusion_iter151.py is periodically wiped by the datto sync job, so datto evidence disappears after 1-2 min and PC-MARIO confidence drops from 91 → 86 (below the 88 threshold advertised in the review). Not a fusion bug, but the seed is not durable enough for slow CI runs.

action_items: Optional: make the fusion seed durable — either pause the datto poller during tests, or upsert a datto_client_links entry that pins the test datto docs, so datto evidence for PC-MARIO doesn't vanish between runs.
critical_code_review_comments: evidence_fusion.py: sound design — softmax over hypothesis weights + independent-source cap (1→65, 2→82, 3→92, 4+→97) + conflict cap 60. Non-discriminating sources (ping when connector live, calendar) correctly excluded from the source-count cap via `srcs - {'ping','calendar'}`.

evidence_fusion.fuse: when connector_live is False the ping evidence is skipped (correct — local probes untrustworthy) but Datto/iLO/Nebula/UPS are still consumed, which is the right behavior since those are external sources.

routes/fusion.py cache: 60s in-process dict keyed by client_id. No LRU / no cache-invalidation on config change — acceptable for admin page but note that flipping fusion_v2_enabled does not clear the cache (may confuse admins for up to 60s). Consider clearing `_cache` in put_cfg.
routes/fusion.py: GET /api/fusion/config has no require_admin — any authenticated user can read the toggle (probably intentional but worth confirming).
shutdown_diagnosis._schedule_signal formats the day/date as 'Fri 11/09 23:17' with the ISO 'now' from the seed — locale is English, could be Italian for consistency (minor cosmetic).
seed_data_creation: Ran /app/backend/tests/seed_fusion_iter151.py (as instructed). Must be re-run right before test execution because datto sync overwrites the seeded datto_devices doc.

rca of the issue: Initial run failed with confidence=86 because between the seed step and the API call the periodic datto poller had cleared the seeded datto_devices doc (uid=datto-pc-mario). Without the datto evidence only 4 concordi sources vote intentional_off (score 3.6 → softmax raw 86); with datto 5 sources push raw ≥91. Repro: run seed → wait 1-2 min → GET fusion/device — sources goes from 5 to 4, conf 91→86. Mitigation: re-run seed script immediately before assertions (adopted in tests) or pin datto_client_links.last_sync_at + add a synthetic datto_devices doc that the poller preserves.
